name: RenderKit/ospray
description: Intel OSPRay: an open, scalable, portable ray tracing engine for high-fidelity scientific visualization supporting x86, ARM, and Intel GPU via SYCL. Powers visualization tools across HPC and scientific applications.
score_rationale: Intel-backed production renderer with 1.1k stars, widely used in HPC/scientific visualization, actively maintained with GPU support.
summary: Intel production ray tracer for scientific visualization with HPC and GPU support.
